categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Lacks the Utils label; the 2-line edit to ThreadPool::Submit in src/util/threadpool.h is an incidental helper tweak to support the coins caller.
categories.rationale: The change to ThreadPool is incidental to the coins overlay optimization and does not represent an intentional utility improvement.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Carries the 'UTXO Db and Indexes' label and modifies prevout fetching and UTXO view overlays in src/coins.cpp and src/coins.h.
categories.rationale: Reuses heap allocations across blocks and avoids dispatching idle worker threads during parallel prevout fetching. The author claims 'this also results in a 1% validation speedup', making this a worthwhile block-connection optimization though reasonably deferrable without verified benchmarks.
